sources.title: DeepSeek V3.2 - Venice Uncensored AI
sources.snippet: DeepSeek-V3.2 is an efficient large language model with DeepSeek Sparse Attention (DSA) for long contexts. It features strong reasoning and tool-use skills, achieving top results on the 2025 IMO and IOI.

sources.snippet: 🤖 Automated Google AI Model Cycling (Using code from 'ProjectE' of the RimWorld Gallery) Multi-Model Support: Automatically switches between various AI models like Gemini-2.5-flash, Gemini-2.0-flash, and Gemma-3.
